runtime:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished, extremely crisp desktop application UI design image, 1920x1200 landscape, front-facing screenshot with no laptop frame, no perspective, no decorative background, no marketing headline. This is a proposed redesign of ESSim, a Chinese industrial Modbus simulation engineering workbench. It must look implementable in React, Dockview, Tailwind and shadcn/ui, like a mature IDE or network diagnostic instrument, NOT a card dashboard. Use white main surfaces, cool very light gray panel chrome, 1px slate borders, 4px control corners, restrained blue #2563eb accent, subtle green for listening and amber for unapplied configuration, compact precise Chinese typography. No gradients, huge rounded panels, shadows, charts, decorative illustrations, statistic cards.
Maintain fixed shared shell: top app/menu bar 36px high with small ESSim icon and text "ESSim" at far left, "文件  编辑  视图  帮助", right "本次会话"; left docked project tree 228px wide; central document region about 1380px; right property inspector 284px; bottom docked communication region ONLY under central document, 210px high; status footer 22px. Tight engineering density with readable small type. Left heading "项目" with magnifier search and compact plus dropdown. Tree has expanded "模拟器", selected green-dot "PCS TCP 从站" with children "Unit 1 · PCS", "Unit 2 · PCS"; expanded "模型库" with "PCS 标准模型", "BMS 标准模型"; collapsed "设备". No extra left activity rail.
Central tabs single row: inactive "PCS 标准模型", active "PCS TCP 从站", small plus at far right. Below, ONE 40px document action bar with explicit small icon+labels "保存配置" "应用配置", amber dot "待应用", vertical divider then segment "运行 | 配置" with 运行 active; on far right green dot "监听中" and compact outlined "停止". NO second row of giant buttons. Next ONE thin contextual row: "Unit 1 · PCS ▾" "模型 PCS 标准模型 ↗" separator "127.0.0.1:1502" "连接 1/10" "请求 128" "异常 0". A slim amber contextual banner "模型已保存，运行仍使用已应用配置。" with right small link "查看变更". It must be a restrained 28px high banner.
Next 32px GRID action row: left search input "查找点名或地址", right blue button "提交修改 (2)", secondary "恢复初值 ▾", small refresh icon and ellipsis menu. NO connection limit input, no raw JSON dump, no repeated permanent explanations above grid.
Dominant spreadsheet occupies all remaining central body. Dense 28px rows, 28px pale column header, subtle thin grid, frozen row numbers and point name. Columns "点名", "数据区", "零基地址", "类型", "单位", "置数草稿", "实际值", "状态". Display meaningful illustrative rows: 总有功功率 holding 1000 f32 kW 125.0 120.0 amber "待提交"; SOC holding 1002 f32 % 78.5 78.5 muted dash; 总电压 holding 1004 f32 V 768.0 768.0; 总电流 holding 1006 f32 A 160.0 156.0 amber 待提交; 运行状态 holding 1010 u16 -- 1 1. More clean rows below. The two changed draft cells have extremely subtle amber fill with tiny amber left mark. Selecting SOC point name shows thin blue outline only and does not affect refresh scope. Use flat table, no zebra overkill.
At grid bottom a thin category strip with "遥测 128" blue underline active, "遥信 32", "遥控 4", "遥调 8", and right muted "可见行自动刷新 · 500 ms".
Bottom central observation dock tabs "通信报文" active with blue underline, "事件", "问题 1". Toolbar small "当前模拟器 ▾" "全部方向 ▾", right "暂停显示" search icon export icon. Actual structured packet table columns "时间" "方向" "Unit" "功能码" "地址 / 数量" "结果" "耗时"; 3 rows examples 14:32:08.124 RX 1 03 1000 / 8 请求 —;14:32:08.126 TX 1 03 1000 / 8 成功 2 ms;14:32:09.124 RX 1 0F 2000 / 4 请求 —. A tiny one-line hex detail at very bottom, not large code dump.
Right inspector header "属性", context "SOC · Unit 1", small tabs "点" active "Unit" "端点". Simple compact property grid labels and values: 点名 SOC; 四遥分类 遥测; 数据区 holding; 零基地址 1002; 类型 f32; 单位 %; 外部写入 checked. Divider "运行值" actual 78.5, draft78.5, 更新时间14:32:08. No duplicate unit dropdown in inspector. Advanced section collapsed "编码与倍率"; reference footer small "PCS 标准模型 ↗". No deletion button prominent.
Footer "核心已连接" green tiny dot left, center "当前 Unit 160 点", right amber small "配置仅保留本次会话". Keep every visible string clean and logically placed. Render a believable professional application screenshot, not a presentation slide.
runtime_correction: Edit the attached ESSim UI mockup only for technical and textual accuracy. Preserve the exact layout, visual style, borders, all panel sizes, all controls and every other part. At bottom communication detail row REPLACE the entire hex byte string with exact valid Modbus TCP request "00 01 00 00 00 06 01 03 03 E8 00 08". At bottom-right of that same detail row REPLACE "RTU over TCP 7 字节" with exact "Modbus TCP · 12 字节". No CRC in this TCP request. Right inspector classification value must read exact Chinese "遥测". There are exactly TWO pending changes in the table: first row and fourth row. For the battery highest temperature row, make draft and actual both "32.1"; for insulation resistance make draft and actual both "498.0" so all nonpending rows have equal draft/actual. The "应用配置" icon should be a small outlined document with checkmark, NOT a play triangle; leave its text and position unchanged. Change nothing else. This is a precise UI graphic correction, not a redesign.
model:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high fidelity 1920x1200 landscape, front-on screenshot concept of a Chinese industrial desktop app ESSim MODEL EDITING screen. It must look like a crisp real engineering IDE built from Dockview + shadcn/ui + Tailwind and Excel grid, NOT a card dashboard, poster, diagram, or website. No laptop frame, no perspective, no giant heading, no decorative graphics. Thin cool slate borders, white surfaces, very light gray compact chrome, restrained blue #2563eb, tiny amber pending indicators, readable Chinese sans typography, 4px control radii. Make it restrained and premium, with careful alignment.
Shared shell: app menu bar 36px "ESSim   文件  编辑  视图  帮助", right "本次会话"; left dock 228px "项目" with search and plus menu; tree expanded 模拟器 containing PCS TCP 从站 and Unit1, Unit2, expanded 模型库 containing selected PCS 标准模型 and BMS 标准模型, collapsed 设备. Center document tabs "PCS TCP 从站" inactive, "PCS 标准模型" active, at far right +. Right inspector 284px. Central bottom dock 170px. Footer 22px. No outer card shadows or gradients.
Central ONE 40px document toolbar: "保存模型" a compact blue primary button with save icon; then divider "新增点" small plus, undo and redo icons, right "导入 ▾" "导出 ▾" "列设置" "…" compact text buttons. Far right small amber dot "未保存". No top row duplicated field names with question marks. A subtle contextual one-line 28px amber banner "保存后，2 个引用此模型的模拟器需要重新应用。" and link "查看引用". Next slim 30px search/filter row: small input "点名或地址", chips "数据区：全部 ▾" "类型：全部 ▾", right "共 172 点" and simple help icon.
Dominant dense editable spreadsheet, crisp 28px rows. Default visible columns row number, 点名, 四遥分类, 数据区, 零基地址, 类型, 初始值, 外部写入. Columns should fit without horizontal scrolling; extra byte order, word order, scale, unit, note available via right inspector and 列设置, not permanently crowding default view. Rows: 总有功功率 measurement holding 1000 f32 0 checked; SOC measurement holding 1002 f32 50 checked; 总电压 measurement holding 1004 f32 768 checked; 总电流 measurement holding 1006 f32 0 checked; 运行状态 measurement holding 1010 u16 0 checked; followed by useful rows. One editable SOC initial value 50 cell selected with fine blue border and tiny fill handle. No error flags on valid rows. Slightly amber row marker on edited point; quiet empty rows. Standard Excel gray column headings, row numbers, grid lines.
At bottom of spreadsheet category strip, "遥测 128" active underline blue, "遥信 32", "遥控 4", "遥调 8"; right small "草稿 · 尚未保存". Keep categories at bottom, not extra top navigation.
Right inspector heading "属性", subject "SOC", secondary "点定义 · PCS 标准模型". 2 compact tabs "基础" active and "编码". Property rows with comfortable but compact alignment: 点名 [SOC], 四遥分类 [遥测 ▾], 数据区 [holding ▾], 零基地址 [1002], 类型 [f32 ▾], 初始工程值 [50], 单位 [%], 外部写入 [checked]. Divider "编码与换算" collapsed, small summary "倍率 1 · 大端字节 · 大端字序" beneath as muted text. Below collapsed "引用此模型 2" with small chain icon. No prominent destructive button; put in ellipsis. Field help appears as ONE modest contextual helper sentence at bottom: "零基地址按报文地址填写，不使用 4xxxx 表示法。" with info icon, not permanent questions everywhere.
Bottom observation dock tabs "问题" active with small green check and 0, "引用 2", "事件", "通信报文". Main content compact clean empty state at upper left "校验通过" green tiny check and muted "172 个点，地址与类型检查通过。" Single clean line, not giant centered empty panel. Under "引用" inactive it is not shown. No fake raw JSON. Footer left 核心已连接, center 保存不会自动应用到运行实例, right amber 配置仅保留本次会话.
Use professional schematic application fidelity, legible exact Chinese labels, consistent spacing, no extra invented dashboards. This is design preview illustrative data, not a screenshot claim.
apply:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one crisp 1920x1200 landscape proposed Chinese desktop application screenshot for ESSim, an industrial protocol engineering workbench, showing APPLY CONFIGURATION confirmation. This is the third image of one consistent design language: thin slate lines, white surfaces, cool light gray chrome, blue #2563eb accent, small amber caution, compact Chinese typography, modest 4px control corners. Front-on application only, no hardware frame, no perspective, no presentation headline, no charts/cards/marketing. Like mature professional IDE software built with Dockview and shadcn/ui.
Underlying workbench faithfully visible but dimmed very lightly: top small ESSim menus; 228px left project tree with 模拟器, PCS TCP 从站, Unit1, Unit2, 模型库; central document tabs model and endpoint; endpoint selected; right 284px property pane. Center endpoint in 配置 mode with compact settings form and inline Unit table, NOT cards. Top document action row 保存配置 and 应用配置, amber 待应用. Content underlying left labels 监听地址127.0.0.1, 端口1502; table Unit ID 名称 采集模型 启用, rows1 PCS1 PCS标准模型 checked,2 PCS2 PCS标准模型 checked. Right inspector compact 模拟器属性 with max clients10. Bottom tabs通信报文 事件 问题, quiet packet rows. Footer amber 配置仅保留本次会话.
Foreground centered ONE dialog 820px wide x560px tall with clean white surface, 8px corner, very soft subtle modal shadow, sober precision. Header small icon title exact "应用配置" and close X, subheading "PCS TCP 从站 · 127.0.0.1:1502". One modest amber banner "应用将停止当前端点，并断开 1 个客户端连接。".
Below short scope line "本次范围：完整 TCP 端点 · 2 个 Unit". No checkbox asking vague technical questions, no configuration version selectors.
A dense change summary TABLE with columns "Unit" "模型" "保留运行值" "新增初值" "移除点" "需恢复初值"; rows "Unit 1" "PCS 标准模型" "156" "+4" "−2" "2"; "Unit 2" "PCS 标准模型" "156" "+4" "−2" "2". No cards.
A collapsible open section "需恢复初值的点 · 4" with compact inner table "Unit / 点名 / 原因 / 应用后值": Unit1 总功率 类型由u16变更为f32 0.0; Unit1 故障复位 地址映射变化 false; Unit2 总功率 类型由u16变更为f32 0.0; Unit2 故障复位 地址映射变化 false. This is illustrative proposed interaction, not actual implementation proof.
At bottom a single checkbox checked with exact clear wording "允许以上 4 个点恢复为模型初值". Below small muted explanatory line "其余兼容点保留当前运行值，未提交草稿保留。". Separator. Bottom footer left small muted text "应用后保持停止，需手动启动。" Right aligned secondary "取消" and blue primary "停止并应用". Button widths appropriate for Chinese text. Primary action must clearly say stop-and-apply, not vague confirm. No second confirmation. Accurate coherent Chinese, consistent margins24px, row heights32px, compact professional read-friendly design. Underlying content dim only enough to clarify modal focus.
apply_correction: Precise edit of this ESSim design mockup. Preserve the entire centered "应用配置" modal EXACTLY, its text, position, all rows, colors and button actions. Keep the general underlying workbench layout, but simplify only the background right property inspector: remove EVERY invented network setting for connection timeout, KeepAlive, log level and retry count. Replace that background inspector with these modest sections only: "端点" / 名称 PCS TCP 从站 / 协议 Modbus TCP / 角色 从站 / 监听地址127.0.0.1 / 端口1502, then "连接" / 最大客户端连接数10, then collapsed "高级". Keep the same white/cool-gray thin-border style. Do not introduce any other settings or features. At the background top subnavigation, show only "运行" and "配置" with 配置 active; remove invented 采集点/客户端/日志 tabs. Foreground modal remains pixel-perfect unchanged. This is a conservative current-scope UI concept, not a feature expansion.
